title: Thyroid Storm (Crisis)
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Thyroid storm is one of the most life-threatening endocrine emergencies, resulting from exacerbation of manifestations of thyrotoxicosis.
It should be considered in very sick patients if they present with recent history of thyrotoxicosis and a recent history of precipitating factor.

blocks.text: DI is a disorder of water balance caused by non-osmotic renal loss of water leading to excretion of large volume of dilute urine

Body Mass Index (BMI) = Weight (kg) ÷ Height² (m²); remains the first step for screening overweight/obesity.

Waist circumference: ≥94 cm in men, ≥80 cm in women indicates increased risk.
